title: TrustOperationPlanV1
description: The bound plan a trust-operation evidence bundle (evidence.schema.json) is checked against to produce a report (report.schema.json). Frozen per issue #1714, checkpoint 1 revision 2. Supplied scope/approval information in a plan can never itself authorize execution. The definitions.context_identity block here MUST stay byte-identical to the same-named definition in evidence.schema.json (tests/trust_operation_v1_contract.rs asserts this); that identity is the canonical binding rule between a plan and an evidence bundle's context claim.

manifest_version.description: Version of tests/fixtures/trust_operation_v1/manifest.json this plan was bound against.

evidence_id.description: The evidence bundle this plan is bound to. A conforming evidence bundle carries the SAME value in its own top-level evidence_id (evidence.schema.json); a mismatch is invalid_evidence, checked by the fixture-level contract test, not by this schema alone (cross-document checks are outside single-document JSON Schema validation).

command_digest.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the exact command bytes this plan binds to. A changed command invalidates the plan.

normalized_destination.description: Lexically normalized destination path (tilde/./.. resolved against a supplied cwd). No filesystem probing. Canonical binding rule: an observation binds to this plan's destination iff its own normalized_destination_binding string is byte-for-byte equal to this value.

before_hash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the raw before-mutation bytes of the artifact named by before_artifact_ref.

before_artifact_ref.description: Optional pointer to the actual raw bytes this plan's before_hash was computed from (an offline fixture file under tests/fixtures/trust_operation_v1/artifacts/, or inline base64). Never a network or live-store location. When present, the contract test re-hashes these bytes and asserts the result equals before_hash.

count.description: Exact approved occurrence count to remove for this fingerprint. after == before - approved, never more. Must equal byte_ranges.length.

byte_ranges.description: Explicit [start, end) byte offsets within the before_artifact_ref bytes for each approved occurrence of this fingerprint. Binds the abstract 'count' to actual bytes: the contract test slices before_artifact_ref[start:end] for each range and asserts sha256(slice) == target_sha256. An empty array is valid only when count=0 (the already-satisfied / no-write case).

approved_transformation.description: v1 supports exactly one transformation kind; this is a closed enum until a reviewed manifest change adds another. An append-shaped operation (tee -a, >>) is categorically a different, unsupported transformation kind and MUST NOT be bound to a plan with this value (see manifest.json rows T004/T005 and docs/trust-operation-contract.md).

must_be_readable.description: When required=true, this must also be true: an unreadable backup is the same as no backup for the purpose of this contract.

overwrite_existing.description: An existing different backup is never overwritten.

allOf.$comment: A plan that requires a backup must also require it be readable; 'required but unreadable is fine' is not representable.
A real mutation (at least one approved removal with count>0) can never disable the backup requirement. Fixes the #1715 review finding: 'a mutating plan can disable backup'.
count must equal the number of bound byte ranges for every removal row; this is the explicit occurrence-identity-to-bytes binding the #1715 review asked for.

items.$comment: JSON Schema draft-07 cannot compare count to byte_ranges.length directly without a custom keyword; this is enforced by tests/trust_operation_v1_contract.rs (fn approved_removal_ranges_count_matches_byte_ranges_length), not by this schema alone. Left as a documented limitation rather than a silently-missing check.

artifact_ref.description: Bounded, offline-only reference to actual raw bytes. Exactly one of fixture_path or inline_base64 must be set. NEVER a URL, host path outside the fixtures tree, or any form of network/live-store resolution.

fixture_path.description: Required and exclusive when source=fixture_file. Always relative to the repository root, always under the frozen artifacts directory.

inline_base64.description: Required and exclusive when source=inline_base64. Bounded to 4096 bytes decoded (matches the existing base64-decode cap in src/safety/normalize.rs, #1687), enforced by the fixture-level contract test.
